title: Nova Origins
summary: A research explorer for space, time, and ancient history. Trace signals across the sky, follow light near a black hole, and preview the human past.

details.useCase: Start with something you can see, then explore the evidence behind it: an archive signal, a black-hole calculation, or a feature on an ancient fossil.
details.role: Research interface design and implementation, with a focus on helping visitors read the evidence.
details.progress: The signal field, source map, and black-hole research program are live on Nova Origins. Ancient Civilizations is planned for the main site. You can try its fossil image study here in the portfolio.

title: GOOCI Receipts
summary: Trace a corporate claim to its source and see where the evidence runs out.

details.useCase: Make a corporate claim inspectable by showing its supporting evidence and coverage limits.
details.role: Designed the web experience around source-backed corporate intelligence.
details.progress: The public website is at goociusa.com. The portfolio exercise uses a fictional receipt.

title: Hire One
summary: Help small businesses identify repetitive work and scope a practical first AI workflow.

details.useCase: Turn a recurring business task into a workflow that can be discussed in a discovery session.
details.role: Built the discovery website and its intake experience.
details.progress: The portfolio includes a workload calculator with illustrative inputs. Visit gethireone.com for Hire One.

title: Agent Forge Academy
summary: Gamified agentic design and learning skills world monitor. Recreated and customized from an open-source GitHub repository to study multi-agent architecture.

details.useCase: A hands-on way to learn multi-agent design by playing through agent roles, handoffs, and monitoring.
details.role: Adapted and customized the open-source base; reworked the agent flow and monitoring views for study.
details.progress: Base repository recreated locally. Next: custom agent roles and a progress monitor.

title: Career Search Assistant
summary: AI-powered workflow assistant built to streamline job discovery, role alignment, and application tracking.

details.useCase: Reduce the manual load of job searching by matching roles to a profile and tracking applications in one place.
details.role: Designed the workflow, prompt chains, and tracking data model.
details.progress: Active build. Core matching flow works end to end. Next: application status tracking and follow-up reminders.

title: AI Build Lab
summary: A generative AI learning portal and interactive sandbox for testing prompts, models, and practical business use cases.

details.useCase: A sandbox to compare prompts and models against real business tasks before committing to a workflow.
details.role: Built the sandbox structure and prompt-testing flow; curating use cases.
details.progress: Sandbox and first use-case set are live internally. Next: side-by-side model comparisons.
